content.text: Created PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel-toolbox/pull/69
, Please take a look.
This is good, pending some minor code review comments. The main issue is keeping SNAPSHOT releases out of the dependencies. So, this will require at least a new release of fcrepo-camel.

do you have a need for the latest updates to fcrepo-java-client (e.g. the support for system properties) to be part of this? That would require, first, a patch release of fcrepo-java-client; and second, a patch release of fcrepo-camel. That's completely fine, from my perspective, but it would be helpful to know.
Hi

, made the minor fixes you suggested, but couldn't switch back to the stable version of fcrepo-camel due to failing test. I think I wouldn't make sense to fix those tests only to undo them when we cut the next release.
Yes, It would be helpful for us have new releases cut. Also, I will be making a new PR for adding HTTPS/SSL support fcrepo-indexing-solr.
? Is there an existing ticket for updating fcrepo-camel-toolbox to use fcrepo-java-client? This current issue depends on that, no?
AFAIK, fcrepo-camel already uses the fcrepo-java-client:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel/blob/master/pom.xml#L55
, indeed:
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1815
So the dependency on moving this current ticket forward is a new release of fcrepo-camel and fcrepo-camel-toolbox?

once there is a new release of fcrepo-camel, we can move forward with this ticket. Given the recent activity with fcrepo-java-client, I've been waiting on the 0.1.2 release of that project before cutting a new release of fcrepo-camel.
Merged via
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel-toolbox/commit/e13924eb9427e8590c92754d91be90cc98e0b096
Update fcrepo-camel-toolbox client code imports. With FCREPO-1815, the client code were extracted to a separate project which changed the package of the code.
Note:
doesn't affect fcrepo-camel-toolbox yet, since it depends on the 4.4.0 of fcrepo-camel.
